title: code-with-muskan17/rag-based-ai-teaching-assistant
summary: 基于RAG（检索增强生成）的AI教学助手，利用Whisper语音识别、Gemini嵌入和Streamlit框架，通过视频讲座内容回答问题，实现高效的教学辅助。，基于模型推理的架构
description: AI-powered teaching assistant that answers questions about course video lectures using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) — built with Whisper, Gemini embeddings, and Streamlit.
